question: An electron in a hydrogen atom is associated with a de Broglie wavelength. Explain why only certain circular orbits are stable in Bohr model using the condition for standing matter waves.

options.A: Circular orbits match high frequency bounds exclusively where orbital radii remain smaller than the particle size.
options.B: Every random pathway acts as a standing wave because wave frequencies adapt continuously without discrete limits.
options.C: Only orbits where the circumference is a fractional multiple of the de Broglie wavelength can stay stable over time.
options.D: Only certain circular orbits are stable because only in these orbits the electron matter wave forms a standing wave.
